class.name: NNNQSQuerySensor
class.brief_description: Runs an NQS query asynchronously, exposing its best score and writing the winning node to the blackboard.
class.description: Posts [member nqs_search_space] to [NNNodeQuerySystem] so spatial queries run within the per-frame time budget without blocking. Once a query finishes, [member NNSensors.sensor_value] holds the best result's score (or [code]0.0[/code] if nothing matched) and the winning node is written to [member best_result_key] on the owning root's blackboard. Use this when a utility AI behaviour needs to both check whether a good target/spot exists (via the sensor score) and act on the chosen node (via the blackboard).

members.member: Blackboard key where the winning node is stored on completion (or erased if no results matched). Leave empty to skip blackboard writes.
If [code]true[/code], posts the query to the [NNNodeQuerySystem] high-priority queue.
